name: Adjuvant Ribociclib + Aromatase Inhibitor (NATALEE)
cyclesNote: 3 years (39 cycles of 28 days) in combination with a nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor (letrozole 2.5 mg or anastrozole 1 mg daily).

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: NATALEE: Slamon D, Lipatov O, Nowecki Z, et al. N Engl J Med 2024;390:1080-1091
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-K, BINV-M)

biomarkers.note: Requires HR-positive and HER2-negative stage II or III early breast cancer meeting NATALEE criteria: any positive lymph nodes (excluding micrometastases alone); or if node-negative, tumor size >5 cm, or tumor size 2-5 cm with either grade 2 (and high genomic risk or Ki-67 ≥20%) or grade 3. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-K (3 of 4) and BINV-M (5 of 10) (Category 1, Preferred).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (ductal/NST, lobular, mixed, micropapillary)
supportiveCare: QTc interval vigilance: perform ECG prior to starting. Only initiate if QTcF < 450 ms. Avoid concomitant strong CYP3A inhibitors and QT-prolonging medications.
Neutropenia monitoring: assess CBC regularly. Myeloid growth factors are not routinely required.
Hepatotoxicity monitoring: monitor liver enzymes before starting and periodically.
Partner aromatase inhibitor: give with daily letrozole 2.5 mg or anastrozole 1 mg. Premenopausal patients must receive concurrent ovarian function suppression (GnRH agonist).
monitoring: ECG at baseline, Day 14 of Cycle 1, Day 1 of Cycle 2, and as clinically indicated (hold if QTcF > 480 ms)
CBC with differential prior to starting, every 2 weeks for the first 2 cycles, at Day 1 of each subsequent 4 cycles, then as clinically indicated
Liver function tests prior to starting, every 2 weeks for the first 2 cycles, at Day 1 of each subsequent 4 cycles, then as clinically indicated
clearanceChecks: liver function tests (transaminases ≤ 3x ULN, bilirubin ≤ ULN)

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ribociclib until QTcF < 480 ms. Resume at reduced dose level (400 mg -> 200 mg; permanently discontinue if QTcF > 500 ms or prolonged with Torsades de pointes).
Hold ribociclib until resolution to grade ≤ 2 (ANC ≥ 1000/mcL). Resume at the same 400 mg dose for first occurrence. For recurrent grade 3 or any grade 4, resume at reduced dose (200 mg daily).
Hold ribociclib until recovery to baseline or grade ≤ 1. Resume with dose reduction (200 mg daily). If grade 4 transaminitis (>20x ULN), permanently discontinue.

drugs.name: Ribociclib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. Ribociclib 400 mg PO once daily on Days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle for 3 years (39 cycles), combined with a nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor.
